optionReasons.saa-med-152:option:1: The T family is burstable with EBS — even by far it sustains millions of IOPS local.
optionReasons.saa-med-152:option:2: The C family optimizes CPU — its instance store (when it exists) is not the massive NVMe of the family I.
optionReasons.saa-med-152:option:3: EBS gp3 even at most is storage DE REDE — major latency and ceiling of IOPS far below the local NVMe of the family I.

finalJustifications: Because the I family brings NVMe SSD LOCAL of the highest IOPS and minimum latency — designed for NoSQL self-management (Cassandra) with millions of random operations per second.
Because the I family replicates the local NVMe to the EBS automatically, combining local disk speed with network durability.
Because the I family is the only one approved to run Cassandra on AWS, with optimized drivers in the Nitro instance hypervisor.
Because the local NVMe of the family I persists the data after the end of the instance, exempting the replication of Cassandra himself.

Because the Computer Savings Plan copper also RDS and ElastiCache, extending the commitment discount to the rest of the company's production architecture.
Because the Computer Savings Plan doubles the discount for Graviton instances, rewarding the C5 to C6g migrations planned by the FinOps team.

optionReasons.saa-med-197:option:0: The I.R.'s stalling the hour, but still paying 24/7 by 57 idle minutes every hour.
optionReasons.saa-med-197:option:1: Spot continuously connected still pays idle time — and can be interrupted.
optionReasons.saa-med-197:option:3: Larger instance costs MAIS and does not eliminate idleness — it only shortens the 3 working minutes.

finalJustifications: Because the routine of ~3 min/hour fits in Lambda (limit 15 min): o EventBridge Scheduler invokes every hour and only the executed time is paid — the 57 idle minutes cost zero.
Because Lambda compresses and moves files faster than any instance EC2, thanks to the internal parallelism of the runtime managed.
Because EventBridge executes the routine without cost within the Free Tier forever, and the Lambda charges only the first invocation of the day.
Because Lambda binds the instance EC2 only during 3 minutes of processing, automatically shutting it down at the end of the routine.

optionReasons.saa-med-245:option:0: All at Eleven updates everything together — DOWNTIME guaranteed and rollback via manual redo.
optionReasons.saa-med-245:option:2: Immutable is safe and downtimeless, but rollback IMEDIATO with one click back is the differential of Blue/Green via URL swap.
optionReasons.saa-med-245:option:3: Rolling with Additional Batch maintains capacity, but the rollback in the middle of the process is slow and complex — not 'immediate'.

finalJustifications: Because Blue/Green creates the full green environment, tests and does Swap Environment Instant URLs — zero downtime, and rollback is another swap back to the preserved blue.
Because Blue/Green updates existing instances one by one without creating a new environment, keeping half the fleet in each version.
Because the URL swap also migrates the bank data between environments, ensuring that the green assumes the updated state.
Because the green environment is free until it receives production traffic — the AWS only collects the second environment after the definitive swap of the CNAMes.

optionReasons.saa-med-269:option:1: Elastic Inference is split acceleration for INFERENCE in SageMaker — does not resolve cold start of instances GPU of the EC2.
optionReasons.saa-med-269:option:2: Spot does not eliminate cold start — launch and initialize the instance GPU equal delay (and there may not even be capacity).
optionReasons.saa-med-269:option:3: Lambda It doesn't. GPU — containers with heavy ML model in Lambda do not replace instances GPU.

finalJustifications: Because Warm Pool maintains pre-initialized instances (stopped = only cost of EBS): in the scale-out they are promoted in seconds, without paying GPU idle 24/7.
Because Warm Pool keeps the GPU physically heated in the datacenter, eliminating the time of thermal startup of the hardware.
Because Warm Pool preloads the ML jobs before they arrive, processing the image queue in advance.
Because Warm Pool lends instances to other customers on standby, paying only shared usage time.

Because the RI Standard allows to exchange instance families every quarter, following the optimizations of the critical application.
Because the All Upfront payment exempts the company from the monthly billing taxes, adding the tax economy to the discount.
Because the RI Standard of 3 years includes reserved capacity in two regions, ensuring the failover without additional booking cost.
